subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw accept outbound Telegram album/sendMediaGroup semantics in the bundled Telegram plugin now, and should maintainers port the linked draft implementation or ask for a narrower redesign?
rationale: This is a new user-facing Telegram send behavior and message-tool surface, and there is already an open draft implementation candidate that maintainers need to accept, port, or supersede before automation creates another path.

options.title: Review or port the linked implementation
options.body: Use the draft fork PR as source material, but require a current-main Telegram plugin design with fallback behavior, docs, tests, and live proof before merge.

options.title: Ask for a narrower redesign
options.body: Keep the issue open but close or supersede the draft if maintainers want album behavior only in selected outbound paths or under different message-tool semantics.

options.title: Defer album support
options.body: Leave sequential mediaUrls as the supported behavior for now and close only after maintainers explicitly decide Telegram album grouping is not planned.

recommendation.title: Review or port the linked implementation
recommendation.body: Use the draft fork PR as source material, but require a current-main Telegram plugin design with fallback behavior, docs, tests, and live proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already left the substantive cleanup analysis on this issue and has recent history across the affected Telegram/plugin boundaries.
